svg.title: III. The sky of projects
svg.desc: The sky of projects, in four constellations. Lead & team: PvZ Fusion. Video games: Omnicard, Bloodborne Legendary Run, League Of Data Base. Tools: gup, GitHealth. AI: Karl Scraper, Sillage, Relais.

text.tspan: Nine projects, four constellations. Each star proves something.
